Touch: Success=attacker has made contact with the opponent.
Grapple: If successful touch, attacker STR Save vs opponent's AGL Save. Win=grapple.
Strangle: If successful touch while grapple, attacker STR Save vs opponent's STR Save. win=damage at the end of each 10 second round. Rigid armor blocks this attack.
Claw: If successful touch while grapple. Some races will have higher claw damage.
Bite: If successful touch while grapple. Some races will have higher bite damage.
Escape: While grapple, escaper's AGL Save vs opponent's AGL Save. Win=escape.
Ear Rip: If successful Called Shot while grapple. Damage to ear/antenna.
Eye Gouge: If successful Called Shot while grapple. Damage to eye.
Hold: While grapple, attacker's AGL Save vs opponent's AGL or STR Save. Win=held (no opponent attacks), Loss=still grapple.
Pin: While grapple, attacker's AGL Save vs opponent's STR Save. Win=pinned(no opponent attacks/escape is 1/2 chance), Loss=still grapple.
Tackle: If successful touch, attacker STR Save vs opponent's AGL Save. Win=grapple and both attacker and opponent prone.
Throw: While grapple, attacker's STR Save vs opponent's AGL or STR Save. Win=thrown 1' and does 1d4 per 10% difference in Saves.
Slam: While grapple, force skill roll,attacker's STR Save vs opponent's AGL or STR Save. Win=thrown 1' and does 1d4x2 per 10% difference in Saves.
